decks.notes: This deck focuses on combining aggressive creature plays with disruption and removal spells to control the board and maintain pressure on the opponent. Utilizing powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Faerie Mastermind, along with control cards like Make Disappear and Go for the Throat, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and disrupt their game plan. With a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, this Dimir Aggro deck is designed to apply constant pressure and keep the opponent on the defensive.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage to out-value the opponent. The deck includes cards like Dissipate, Negate, and Sheoldred's Edict to disrupt the opponent's strategy, as well as Memory Deluge and The Wandering Emperor to draw cards and generate advantage. The deck also includes win conditions like Siphon Insight and Cut Down to finish off the opponent once the game is under control. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and outlast the opponent through efficient resource management and disruption.

The deck focuses on controlling the board through removal and disruption spells while leveraging card advantage with Phyrexian Arena and The Celestus. It aims to outvalue opponents by generating recurring value from graveyard interactions and planeswalkers like Sorin the Mirthless, Kaya, Intangible Slayer, and Liliana of the Veil. The deck also utilizes powerful win conditions like Archangel Elspeth and The Wandering Emperor to close out games. With a strong mana base to support its strategy, the Orzhov Control deck aims to grind out opponents and maintain control of the game until victory.

This Dimir Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creatures like Evolved Sleeper and Faerie Mastermind, supported by powerful removal spells like Go for the Throat and Cut Down. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and synergy with graveyard recursion cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Ertai Resurrected make this deck a formidable and versatile opponent in Standard 1 vs 1 matches. The strategy revolves around maintaining board presence while disrupting the opponent's game plan, leading to quick victories through relentless aggression and control.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through various counterspells, removal spells, and card draw effects. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining card advantage and eventually winning the game through card advantage or a powerful finisher. The deck includes a mix of creature removal, counterspells, card draw, and lands that produce multiple colors of mana to support the control strategy. It also includes powerful finishers like The Wandering Emperor and Sheoldred's Edict to close out the game.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm and disrupt the opponent with a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. The creatures in the deck provide additional threats and resilience, while the spells help to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect your own creatures. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent through incremental advantages and controlling the pace of the game until it can deploy its game-winning threats and secure victory.
